title: The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society
author: Mary Ann Shaffer
summary: In 1946, a London writer begins corresponding with the members of a book club on the island of Guernsey, formed during the German occupation, and travels there to learn what happened to them.
readIf: you like warm, letter-based historical fiction about community and books.
skipIf: you want gritty war fiction or fast plotting.
